parameter_semantics: source_object selects the observed manipulated container used in phase and co-motion features; destination_object selects the observed bowl whose pose is the per-chunk Cartesian action frame. These are semantic references, not phase labels or actuator inputs.
output_semantics: Each slot is an absolute Cartesian TCP target expressed in the destination bowl pose frozen at chunk construction: bowl-frame position xyz in metres, bowl-frame orientation as the first two rotation-matrix columns (6D), and one native gripper scalar. The decoder projects 6D to SO(3), left-composes the frozen bowl pose, and calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh measured joints. Slots represent t-1 through t+14; execution uses slots 1 through 8. The gripper scalar retains >=0 open and <0 close semantics. A training-only masked auxiliary classifies causal open/approach, closed-low, or closed-lifted state and does not alter decoding.

conversion_check.description: Compose an encoded bowl-frame target with the same chunk bowl pose and compare FK of IK output to the demonstrated commanded TCP in metres/radians, with unchanged gripper scalar. Robust Gram-Schmidt only projects sampled 6D rotations; encoded labels are exact.

cut_relation: Uses all twelve assigned [0,360) segments and retains the complete [180,360) action-supervised successor overlap. The causal phase auxiliary refines conditioning without changing the cut, future access, success definition, or handoff responsibility.
